lines.differs: Easier for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: Payment is conditional on AtliQ receiving funds from the end client, rather than a fixed 30-day term.
Easier for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: Payment depends on AtliQ getting paid by its own client, instead of a standard 45-day window.
Easier for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: AtliQ only pays the vendor after receiving payment from the end client, shifting cash flow risk to the vendor.
Same as Rohan Iyer: Both protect non-public information and materials of both AtliQ and its clients with similar use and disclosure restrictions.
Broadly like Meridian Healthcare: Both require strict confidentiality and restricted access to personnel, though this excludes the 24-hour breach notification requirement.
Broadly like Al Noor Hospitality Group: Both mandate strict confidentiality and use for the purpose, though this focuses more on AtliQ and client data.
Tougher on AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: The vendor retains all rights to annotation outputs and guidelines, whereas previously AtliQ received a broad perpetual license.
Tougher on AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: The vendor retains ownership of all deliverables and annotation outputs, rather than AtliQ owning specifically developed work product.
Tougher on AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Vendor keeps all rights to annotation outputs, unlike the previous deal where specifically developed deliverables belonged to AtliQ.
Easier for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: The vendor must indemnify AtliQ for any breach or act, regardless of whether AtliQ was also negligent.
Easier for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Vendor indemnity is much broader, covering any breach or end client claim rather than just IP or gross negligence.
Easier for AtliQ than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: Vendor provides a comprehensive indemnity for any act or breach, extending beyond simple IP infringement claims.
Easier for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: AtliQ's liability is capped and indirect damages excluded, while the vendor faces unlimited liability for all losses.
Easier for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: The vendor's liability is completely uncapped for any loss, while AtliQ enjoys both a cap and damage exclusions.
Easier for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ's liability is strictly capped at fees paid, while the vendor has no liability limits or damage exclusions whatsoever.
Easier for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: Penalties are 2% of total fees per day, doubled from the previous 1% rate.
Easier for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Penalties are 2% of total fees per day, vs 0.5% of milestone fees per week, with no cap.
Easier for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Liquidated damages are 2% of total fees daily, rather than 1% of the affected milestone fee.
Broadly like PayTrack Technologies: Both use Indian law and Pune jurisdiction, but this replaces arbitration with direct court access for faster escalation.
Easier for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: Disputes are resolved in local Pune courts under Indian law, avoiding expensive Singapore arbitration and SIAC rules.
Easier for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: Uses local Indian law and Pune courts instead of DIFC law and Dubai courts.
